lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Fuel. Filtered twice, labelled once. Twenty units for five crates of supplies.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: That sales pitch did not improve the word filtered.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Transfer is clean. Mostly. Your gauge says twenty, so we are both happy.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Then stop blocking the pump. Someone less cautious is behind you.
